title: ruta montbretii
intro: Ruta montbretii, commonly known as the Mountain Rue, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ruta montbretii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, pinene, and other volatile compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
